articles.title: From the President, Rob Jaworski
articles.summary: The November 2013 San Jose Astronomical Association (SJAA) newsletter, "The Ephemeris," details upcoming events such as star parties and a general meeting featuring a talk on solar seismology. President Rob Jaworski reports on facility updates, including a new observing site permit, but primarily issues an urgent call for volunteers. Key positions, including the newsletter editor and a Board of Directors seat, are vacant due to staff relocations, prompting an appeal for member involvement.
